name: Tivani Mabasa
text: Consulted AXE Connect regarding my business website, and they assisted me in creating it. The website is running perfectly, all thanks to them. Keep up the good work!

name: Ntsikelelo Mpayipeli
text:
Axe Connect designed and built the new Zicco Plumbers website, www.ziccoplumbers.co.za, and it has made a real difference to how we work.

Customers can now see all our services, request a quote online with a photo of the problem, and get a ticket number to track their job. On our side, we have a simple dashboard where we update jobs, book visits and send quotes and invoices by email straight from the system.

The website was set up on our own domain and hosting, connected to Google so new requests come straight to our email, and made ready for Google searches. Carven was easy to work with, explained everything in plain language and made changes quickly whenever we asked.

We'd recommend Axe Connect to any business that wants a professional website that actually brings in work.

name: Ndhavuko Previllage
text:
I have used Axe Connect for a variety of services, including logo design, laptop and computer repairs, IT support and troubleshooting, software installation, and virus removal and performance optimisation.

My experience has consistently been positive. Their service is timely, professional, and affordable, and they communicate clearly throughout the process. The logo design work met my expectations, and the technical support provided for my computer-related issues was efficient and effective.

What stands out most is their reliability. Because of the quality of service I received, I have continued to return to Axe Connect for all my IT-related needs. I would confidently recommend Axe Connect to individuals, startups, and businesses looking for dependable technical support, computer repairs, web services, or design solutions.
